book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso tuŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ, bo taashɛ bo to. Wu nya bo bvuŋga bɛ je yì bo bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele ye yi bamii le bo ka fɛde binchɛŋ,
wu mo wu tuŋ bo lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bo fêeji bamii kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bo ka fɛde bamii ba binchɛŋ.
Wu ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne, keefɛ muh jô fiɛɛ gɛ. Keefɛ muh jô kimbaŋ gɛ, mo nyume kikɛɛ gɛ, mo nyume fiɛɛ fijile gɛ, mo nyu bige gɛ. Keefɛ muh jô bikuŋ bifɛɛ gɛ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛne bɛŋ lee ntɛ le, yeh yì ba gɛɛ bɛŋ yu, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ chêe gɛh nyu yu gɛɛŋ bu sege bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jâ ntɛ wɛɛ le.
Nɛ ntɛ wumu le wu faŋ ki wu fî bɛŋ, bɛŋ ja yo, sege bɛŋ bude bɛŋ kaajɛ bibvunɛ bi yi bikaa biɛna le, fi ge fi nyume njiŋɛ yi fiɛɛ fì bo moŋ le.”

content: Bo mo bo ja bo gɛɛne, bo gɛɛŋ bo tu bo jiɛnyi bantɛ le bantɛ le, bo feeji saaka wù joŋe wu kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo, bo mo bo fɛde bamii ba binchɛŋ bachii.
Saaka kune Jiso fuuŋsɛ Hɛlod
Hɛlod wù gɛ̀ sage kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee yu mwɛɛ munchii mù gɛ̀ kooshi, mu fuuŋsɛ wu nje bamii bamu gɛ̀ jade bo duu lɛ Jiso wunɛ le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo wu kaase wu bu.
Bamu duu lɛ le Alaja wu kaase wu to. Bamu duu fiboo lɛ le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wu fweele wumu wu kaase wu bu yi kwe le.
Hɛlod mo wu ghaa lɛ, “Joŋ le nche mbvusɛ wa kikwɛɛ ke. Wunɛ muh ka nyume yɛɛŋ mɛɛse wù mɛ n'yuge kfuu chi munɛ mwɛɛ kune wu?” Wu mo wu goone lɛ wu bee wu yɛŋ Jiso wɛɛ le.
Jiso nyaŋe bamii banchvuge batɛŋ
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ, bo sɛɛŋ mwɛɛ munchii mù bo ge fɛ wu le. Wu mo wu ja wu jo bo bɛ bo kɛŋsɛ yo, bo bu bo gɛɛne je yi a kinlaantɛŋ kì Bɛsada le.
Geenɛ, kinchvu ki bamii kɛɛ ki kuŋe ki bii wu le, wu fi bo wu mo wu kɛ wu feeji kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo wu ka fɛde bamii ba chɛne.

Lɛ juu doo chi gɛɛne ki chi selɛ, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ bo kɛŋsɛ bo to bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Dû lɛ bamii banɛ le lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bantɛ bɛ ala a mbebe le, bo gû mwɛɛ muboo munjile bɛ fɛ bo lé bo chê fo, nje fɛnɛ le nchvuuŋ.”
Jiso chvuu fie lɛ,

content.text: “Le bɛŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ nyâ bo fiɛɛ fì bo lé bo jî.”

content: Bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fì bee kɛme le gɛh chefe yi blɛd yishɛŋ bɛ bíɛŋ yifiɛɛ. Fuge noo sɛŋ tu wo goone lɛ bee gɛɛŋ be gu lo mwɛɛ munjile ŋguu le fɛ bee to be nya bamii banɛ le bachii.”
Bo gɛ̀ duu noo nje bamii gɛ̀ bee fo wesee, bilɛŋsɛ maa gɛ̀ bee njɛ banchvuge batɛŋ. Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ du bamii baa shiiyɛ fɛkuu manjuu le manjuu le, njɛ mbaanshɛŋ, mbaanshɛŋ.”

content: Bo jɛmɛ, bo mo bo shiiyɛ bo bachii.
Jiso jo chefe yi blɛd yi yishɛŋ chiɛɛ bɛ bíɛŋ yi yifiɛɛ chiɛɛ, wu bijɛ we, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu mo wu bwɛɛyɛ wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ bo gâ binchvu bi bamii baa le.
Bo gajɛ, bamii bachii ji bo fuu, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo baanyɛ bimbɛge bì gɛ̀ gweeyɛ, bi yisɛ ŋkaa yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ.
Bita chiɛɛ lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka
Lɛ nyu juu chimi, Jiso buune wu maa, booŋ be ba ŋgoo nyu mbebe ye le. Wu ja wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii duu lɛ nle yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Bamii bamu duu lɛ wo le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo, bamu lɛ Alaja, bamu duu lɛ wo le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wu fweele wumu wu kaase wu bu yi kwe le.”
Wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ duu finɛ lɛ nle yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bita chvuu lɛ, “Wo le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.”
Jiso mo wu chiisɛ bo le lɛ keefɛ bo ka bo môŋ lo bo sɛ̂ɛŋ finɛ muh le gɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ kune baŋgɛ bɛ kwe ye
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme ki wu gê wu yɛŋ baŋgɛ ba duude, bamii ba sage woŋ bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo faŋ wu. Bo mo bo yuuyɛ wu, aju fe atade, wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le.”

content: Kintaaŋ ki muh wù bii Jiso le
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bamii le bachii lɛ,

content.text: “Muh nɛ goone ki wù nyu muh waŋ, tu wù kɛme ki wu fâŋ kikwɛɛ ke, wu tûude kintaaŋ ke aju achii wu bii mɛne.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wù baji kinche ke, tu wu lé wu gê wu lɛsɛ gɛh lo ki. Geenɛ, muh wù lɛsɛ kinche ke nje mɛ, tu wu baji lo kinche ke.
Ba banyi woŋ kfunɛ wuchii ba nya muh le, wu ji, ki wu lɛ̂sɛ kɛnɛ ki wu jîŋ kinche ke, mbe we nyu la?

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh kɛme bvuya ki wu bîi mɛne mo jɛ yaŋ le, wu mo wu kee lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu kɛ̂me tɛ bvuya fɛ mwɛdɛ le sege wu kaasɛ wu to antɛnɛɛ a bvukugɛ bwe, bvù ka nyume tɛ bvu Nyo wù le chiji banchɛndaa be ba yuude.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, bamii bamu lɛme fɛnɛ bo nyu gɛ bo to bo yu wuŋ wu kwe gɛ fɛ bo yɛŋ mo fɛ Nyo sage bvunfoŋ bwe fo gɛ.”

content: Nfiɛɛnɛ yi Jiso kusɛ
Gɛ̀ bee gɛh njɛ aju nyaaŋ, no Jiso jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ, wu jo Bita bɛ Joŋ mo Jɛm bɛ bo bɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ wumu le lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu buunɛ.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu doo wu buune, nfiɛɛnɛ ye ja yi kusɛ, nju ye tɛ kusɛ yi tu yi baaŋ yi lale nɛ mwawmwawmwaw.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii bafɛɛ, nyu Musɛ bɛ Alaja gɛ̀ bee bo ja bo bunɛ bo tu bo jɛme bɛ Jiso.
N'yulɛ wù Nyo baaŋ yi bo le. Bɛ bo jɛme kune kwe yi Jiso gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu kwe Yɛlusalɛm ki fi gê fi to fi kojɛ no Nyo gɛ̀ gɛlɛ.
Bo gɛ̀ jɛme noo, Bita bɛ Joŋ mo Jɛm lefɛ goge lo bo. Bo doo bo kaŋsɛ, bo yɛŋ no n'yulɛ wù Nyo baaŋ ye yi Jiso le, bo ka bo yɛŋ bamii bafɛɛ baa le bo lɛme bɛ wu.

Bamii ba bafɛɛ bayu doo bo baa bikaa, Bita ja wu bunɛ wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Chiji Kikwɛɛ, fi joŋe no bee le fɛnɛ. Chinɛ bee jooŋ chúŋ yishɛde, yimi nyu yo, yimi nyu yi Musɛ, yimi nyu yi Alaja.” Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo, wu kee gɛ mo fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme gɛ.
Gɛh no wu baaŋ wu jɛme noo, kimbɛ ja ki to a bo we ki baŋɛ bo. Bo tu bo kɛmɛ nfaaŋ no bo gɛ̀ bee a kimbɛ ntɛnɛɛ.
Jɛ bu a kimbɛ kiyu le yi jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wunɛ le Mwa yaŋ wu nle ncha. Bɛŋ yûge wu le.”
No jɛ yɛɛ jɛme noo yi mɛsɛ, bo ja bo yɛŋ Jiso lɛme fo wumaa. Bo gɛ ka bo sɛɛŋ muh fiɛɛ fì bo yɛŋ yi mbegɛ wɛɛ le kife kiyu le gɛ.
Jiso bvusɛ nchɛndaa debele yi mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ le
Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ bu a yuu, bɛ ba Jiso ja yi mbegɛ le bo tu bo bohge. Bo doo bo bohge, bo tasɛ bɛ kinchvu ki bamii kì duude.
Lɛ bo bijɛ bo yɛŋ muh mu wu ja wu tu wu wanɛ a kinchvu kɛɛ ntɛnɛɛ lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, kii wo bijɛ gɛh fɛ mwa yaŋ le. Kagɛ mwa yaŋ wunɛ nɛ.
Kiyo kimi jade kichufɛ wu ki noŋ, wu tage, wu funɛ, bifuu bude a wu mu. Ki gɛɛne lo bɛ wu, gɛ ki bɛme lɛ wu yɛnɛ gɛ.
Mbe nlɛgɛ wa booŋ buŋ ba ŋgoo lɛ bo bvusɛ kiyo kiyu bo moŋ sɛŋ.”
Jiso yu noo, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “O oo! Kiŋgogɛ kì achiji kì baaŋ lee gɛ fitele yi Nyo le gɛ. Nlé nyû bɛ bɛŋ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbû nɛɛ, nlé ŋkâaŋ shɛ́ŋ bɛ bɛŋ ŋgɛ̂ɛŋ mbû nɛɛ?”

content: Wu mo wu jɛmɛ chiji mwa wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Tô bɛ mwa yo fɛnɛ!”

content: Wu jo wu doo wu too bɛ wu, nchɛndaa debele wɛɛ ka wu chiaasɛ mwa wɛɛ wu noŋ fɛkuu, wu tage. Jiso waŋ kiyo kì yiide kiyu ki bu yi mwa wɛɛ le, wu mo wu tɛmɛ. Jiso mo wu nya wu chiji le.

Bamii bachii yɛŋ bvuŋga bvù le bvu Nyo le, jwe yuŋ bo. Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ kune baŋgɛ be bɛ kwe ye (Macho 17:22-23; Maliku 9:30-32) No bo gɛ̀ baaŋ bo kɛme kiŋgha ki mwɛɛ munchii mù Jiso gɛ̀ gee le, wu ja wu jɛmɛ booŋ bɛ ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yêgɛ chuule fiɛɛ fì nle njɛme bɛŋ le. Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé ba nyû ba gê ba nyâ wu chiaaŋ yi bamii le.”

content: Lɛ wu jɛmɛ noo, bo gɛ kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme gɛ, nje fiɛɛ fimi gɛ̀ baŋe lɛ keefɛ bo kɛ̂ɛ gɛ, geenɛ bo gɛ̀ faŋ ki bo biih kune njɛmɛ wuyu.
Le yɛɛŋ wu le muh wù baaŋ?
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo kɛ kintɛɛnyɛ lɛbolɛbo laa bo le nɛ muh wù baaŋ a bo ntɛnɛɛ le yɛɛŋ la.
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ kwaji fɛ muntele muboo le, wu mo wu jo mwa wù shige wu gɛɛ mbebe ye le,
wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh nɛ fii mwa njɛ wunɛ a jee chaŋ le, tu wu fii nyu mɛ. Muh fii mɛ, tu wu fii nyume muh wù tuŋ mɛ. Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, muh wù jode kikwɛɛ ke njɛ mwa wù shige a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ le wu, wu le muh wù baaŋ.”

content: Muh wù baaŋ baa gɛ jiŋ wo le gɛ, tu wu toone wo
Joŋ biih wu le lɛ, “Chiji kikwɛɛ, bee le be yɛŋ muh mu le wu tɛŋe jee chuŋ fɛ wu bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le, be faŋ, nje gɛ wu nyu muh ŋgoo yese le gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu fie lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ chîde kfuu chi wɛɛ muh gɛ, nje muh wù baaŋ baa gɛ jiŋ bɛŋ le gɛ, tu wu toone lo bɛŋ.”

content: Jiso soge gɛh ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm,bamii ba Samaliya faŋ ki bo fi wu
Kife kì Nyo gɛ̀ bee ki wu jô Jiso wu bɛɛŋ bɛ wu we lɛ ki to ki kojɛ, Jiso soge gɛh ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛne.
Wu doo wu ja, wu tuŋ bamii bamu fwe. Bo gɛɛŋ bo lee ntɛ wumu wu Samaliya le lɛ bo seesɛ kijusɛ yo wu le.
Bamii ba yo kuŋ wu bɛ kijusɛ bo faŋ ki bo fi wu, nje bo gɛ̀ kee lo lɛ wu fede wu gɛɛne nyu Yɛlusalɛm.
Jɛm bɛ Joŋ ba le booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ yu fiɛɛ fiyu, bo biih lɛ, “Tada, bee tɛɛŋ ŋgu we wu shii wu to wu lɛɛshɛ bamii bayu?”
Jiso kaasɛ ye wu waŋ bo,
wu mo wu ja bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo bo mo bo tu bo gɛɛne wa je yi ntɛ wumu le yeye.
Keefɛ muh wu ŋgoo wu Jiso jîiŋe jiŋ gɛ
Bɛ bo doo bo gɛɛne, muh mu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Nlé mbîi wo le manjuu manchii ma wo gɛɛne fo.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Binchombiaŋ kɛme bintuge biboo, munyii mù fuune we kɛme yéh yiboo, geenɛ gɛ̀ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme lo fɛ wu giŋsɛ kikwɛɛ ke fo gɛ.”

content: Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ muh mu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo bîi mɛne!”

content: Muh wɛɛ chvuu lɛ, “Tada, chinɛ mɛne n'ya ŋgɛɛŋ jiiyɛ chijaŋ fɛ mbii wo le.”
Geenɛ Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Chînɛ bamii ba kweeyɛ wa jîiyi biŋkwe biboo, wo gɛ̂ɛŋ fiuŋ wo fêeji kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo.”

content: Muh mu ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Tada, nlé mbîi wo le, geenɛ ya chinɛ ŋgɛɛŋ n'yɛsɛ kfuu chaŋ le fɛ mbii wo le.”
Jiso chvuu muh wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh ŋgvuumɛ bɛ ji ki wu lɛ̂ŋ lɛme, wu ka lɛne wu jiiŋe jiŋ, tu mwɛdɛ baaŋ kojɛ gɛ ki wù nyu antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le gɛ.”

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu le bo taa fo fɛnɛ lɛ, “Le no Alaja gɛ̀ tɛŋe nɛɛ?”
Baŋwa ba kege bamu le bo taa fo fɛnɛ lɛ, “Lɛ gɛ bɛŋ kee kfuu chi muntele mù bɛŋ kɛme gɛ. Bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ gɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gɛ̀ to ki wu yûuyɛ lo bamii gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ to ki wu fî lo bo.”
